2608.00672.title: From Chasing Ghosts to Missed Attacks: Perspectives and Perceptions of SOC Practitioners on LLM Integration, Risks, and Readiness
2608.00672.paper_summary: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) process large volumes of security events, requiring analysts to accurately detect and assess ongoing cyberattacks under time pressure. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) suggest potential benefits for security operations, yet their practical suitability for real-world SOC workflows remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we conducted 25 semi-structured interviews with SOC practitioners who had prior experience with LLMs, complemented by interactive scenarios to anticipate challenges and identify opportunities for the responsible integration of LLM-based tools into SOC workflows. We identified 15 LLM use cases grouped into six functional categories. While LLMs are valued for automating repetitive, low-level tasks such as report automation, practitioners rate high-impact tasks such as incident analysis as not yet feasible, reporting limitations in technical depth, context awareness, and organization-specific knowledge. They locate these limitations less in the models than in the readiness of their SOCs and human factors driving over-reliance. Despite concerns, practitioners express a strong willingness to adopt LLMs, describing competitive pressure that leaves few alternatives. This work contributes an empirical, practitioner-driven analysis of LLM use across SOC roles and organizations and derives concrete design and integration requirements for human-centered, operationally safe LLM-assisted security operations.
2608.00672.paper_summary_zh: 安全運營中心（SOCs）處理大量的安全事件，要求分析師在時間壓力下準確檢測和評估正在進行的網絡攻擊。最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展顯示出對安全運營的潛在好處，但它們在現實世界的SOC工作流程中的實際適用性仍然不甚了解。為了解決這一差距，我們對25位具有LLMs使用經驗的SOC從業者進行了半結構化訪談，並輔以互動場景來預測挑戰並識別負責任地將基於LLM的工具整合到SOC工作流程中的機會。我們識別了15個LLM的使用案例，分為六個功能類別。雖然LLMs因自動化重複的低級任務（如報告自動化）而受到重視，但從業者認為高影響力的任務（如事件分析）尚不具可行性，並報告在技術深度、上下文意識和組織特定知識方面的限制。他們認為這些限制更多地源於他們的SOC的準備程度以及驅動過度依賴的人為因素。儘管存在擔憂，從業者表達了強烈的採用LLMs的意願，並描述了競爭壓力使得幾乎沒有其他選擇。這項工作為LLM在SOC角色和組織中的使用提供了實證的、以從業者為驅動的分析，並衍生出具體的設計和整合要求，以實現以人為中心的、操作安全的LLM輔助安全運營。
